Paragraph: And then Sugreeva snapped off and spread a fully flowered tree-branch of sala tree with many leaves, and sat on it along with Rama.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Seating themselves comfortably to begin strategic discussions.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Sugreeva prepares a simple seat of leaves and shares it equally with Rama.
Outcome/Resolution: Egalitarian seating arrangement demonstrating mutual respect.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Ego: Simplicity, equality, and absence of false pride

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Samana-asana (sharing an equal seat as peers)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sitting together on natural seats symbolizes pure equality and simplicity.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Reflecting egalitarian partnership through unpretentious physical positioning.
